# Sam's Pet Services

> Dog walking, pet visits, overnight pet and house sitting, and smallholding, livestock and horse care in Brackley, Northamptonshire (NN13) and nearby villages. Run by Sam Rockell. Contact by WhatsApp or phone on 07708 431901, or email samrockell@googlemail.com. Open seven days a week. 18 Facebook reviews, 100% recommend.

## Prices (September 2026, GBP, include the first three miles of travel)

- Group walk: 30 minutes £11 weekday / £15 weekend and bank holiday; 1 hour £14 / £20. Dog collected and returned.
- One-to-one walk: 30 minutes £13 / £19; 1 hour £19 / £27.
- Pet visit (feed, water, play, let out, clean out): from £11 weekday / £15 weekend.
- Overnight cat care: £35 a night.
- Overnight dog care: from £50 a night, includes 1 hour of walking, plus £5 for each additional pet.
- Sheep, lambing help, goats, pigs, poultry and horses: priced per job.

## Areas

Brackley, Evenley, Turweston, Whitfield, Westbury, Hinton-in-the-Hedges, Mixbury, Croughton, Syresham, Farthinghoe. Mileage charged beyond three miles.
